headline: Mooring and Weathered Fronts Stay Active
war_summary: The latest figures keep WeatheredExpanseHex and MooringCountyHex as the war’s liveliest strategic fronts. Weathered records 35 base events in twenty-four hours, up slightly from the previous edition, with two in the latest two-hour window; its line now stands at three Warden, five Colonial, and one neutral base, while casualty rates accelerate on both sides. Mooring also reaches 35 daily events, with three in two hours and sharply rising casualties and enlistments; ten bases are Warden-held and two Colonial-held. StlicanShelfHex has edged from ten to eleven daily events, though only one arrived in the latest two hours; ownership remains three Warden and six Colonial. StonecradleHex still shows seventeen daily events, but no fresh movement in the latest six hours and a cooling combat tempo. FarranacCoastHex remains active at seven events for the day, yet has gone quiet over the latest two hours. PalantineBermHex has newly registered three events, all around Leiri Hermanni, with six Warden and one Colonial base. CallahansPassageHex remains a heavy-combat sector without recorded base changes.
